summary.text: Chris Turner is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 12, representing Lincoln and Union, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Chris Turner with committee assignments including Retirement (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Chris Turner's occupation as Business Owner, Medicine Shoppe; Business Development/Community Relations.
It lists Chris Turner's education as Oak Grove High School; Louisiana Tech University.

The House member page lists Chris Turner's committee assignments as Retirement (Chair); Health and Welfare; Appropriations (Interim Member); House Executive Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay; Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget (Interim Member).
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
